title: Seismic requirements for steel cable.
officialText:
The design strength of steel cables shall be determined by the provisions of ASCE 19 except as modified by these provisions.
1. A load factor of 1.1 shall be applied to the prestress force included in T and T as defined in Section 3.12. 3 4
2. In Section 3.2.1, Item (c) shall be replaced with “1.5 T ” and Item (d) shall be replaced with “1.5 T ”. 3 4
